title: Wrathion's Legendary Cloak
summary: Wrathion's Pandaria trials draw both factions into his search for strength against a wider threat.
opening: Wrathion saw a divided Azeroth approaching danger. The trials he set in Pandaria tested champions while revealing his own views of the war.
reviewNote: Preserve faction-specific steps and review the full removed questline's later chapters from original game evidence. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Follow Wrathion's first meeting and his stated fear for Azeroth. Trace the early raid and faction-war trials. Examine Wrathion's search for the origin of mogu power. Review the later Timeless Isle and Siege-era outcome.

chapters.title: An invitation in Pandaria
chapters.body: In Pandaria, Wrathion spoke of a wider danger approaching Azeroth. A divided world offered little comfort against what he feared.

chapters.title: Tests of strength
chapters.body: Trials of strength drew champions into his purpose amid the faction war. Their labor revealed the young dragon’s own judgment of that conflict.

chapters.title: Power in the Thunder King's domain
chapters.body: Wrathion sought the origin of mogu power. The search reached into an older dominion for an answer to the future he feared.

chapters.title: The campaign's end
chapters.body: The road continued toward the Timeless Isle and the age of the siege. Its final consequence remains unfinished in this telling.
